faq_heading: Homes near Mary Jane Shannon Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Mary Jane Shannon Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Mary Jane Shannon Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Mary Jane Shannon Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Mary Jane Shannon Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 76 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,095,000, townhomes $455,000, condos $426,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Mary Jane Shannon Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Mary Jane Shannon Elementary the median was 26 days on the market, closing at 95.9% of the list price, with 5% of sales above the list price for the 76 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Mary Jane Shannon Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Guildford Park Secondary (0.4 km east), Ellendale Elementary (0.8 km north) and Hjorth Road Elementary (0.9 km south-east).

Mary Jane Shannon Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 10682 144 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Mary Jane Shannon Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Mary Jane Shannon Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Mary Jane Shannon Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Mary Jane Shannon Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 76 homes sold within 1 km of Mary Jane Shannon Elementary: 23 houses, 15 townhomes and 38 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $426,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Mary Jane Shannon Elementary

26 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Mary Jane Shannon Elementary in a straight line (20 elementary, 6 secondary; 3 independent). The closest is Guildford Park Secondary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is North Surrey Learning Centre, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Ellendale Elementary (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is Our Lady of Good Counsel (1.0 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Riverdale Elementary (0.9 km). Other elementary schools close by: Ellendale Elementary (0.8 km north), Hjorth Road Elementary (0.9 km south-east), Ecole Riverdale Elementary (0.9 km north-east), Forsyth Road Elementary (1.0 km west), Our Lady of Good Counsel (1.0 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Ellendale Elementary, 0.8 km north of Mary Jane Shannon Elementary.
